description.value: Famous Foods is Vancouver's original natural and bulk foods store, independently owned and operated since 1930, now located on Kingsway in East Vancouver with the entrance on Perry Street. The store carries over 1,000 bulk items including grains, flours, beans, spices, and herbs, alongside full grocery departments for produce, meat, dairy, and bakery. The deli section offers a range of ready-to-eat items — samosas, calzones, pakoras, Jamaican patties, sushi, and more — useful for cyclists looking for a quick, varied meal.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (6 spaces) at 11m; rack (covered) at 56m; rack at 98m. Total: 6 spaces.
